collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Canoe builders from several villages meet to share techniques: share everything, or keep the village's own designs.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Canoe builders from three villages have gathered on Isola to swap techniques. (subject), the village's oldest builder, has a way of shaping the hull that nobody else knows. (friend) says sharing it would make everyone's canoes safer. (subject) says it is what makes Isola's canoes Isola's. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) shows the visitors every curve and cut. They are amazed. In return, they teach a way of lashing outriggers that makes Isola's canoes faster. Everyone's canoes are better. Isola's still look like Isola's.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) shares the general ideas but keeps the hull shape. The visitors understand. They keep their own secrets too. The gathering is friendly and careful, and everyone goes home with something.
